value.rationale: The recent full compactness criterion leaves the numerical distance to compact operators unknown. This resolves that complete natural quantitative invariant for every bounded finite complex composition sum, tracks cancellations exactly, and yields a closed fibre-count formula for a single map. Exact examples show ordinary and essential norms differ and, more significantly, that positive essential norms vary with p even though the previously established compactness property does not. The result is more than a routine renaming or isolated finite computation.
